name: Iori
message: 「Alright, everyone here？」
The five students of Takamura Class were present and accounted for this morning, just as always.

name: Iori
message: 「Well then, we’re finally one week away from the midterm exams！」

name: Iori
message: 「It is no exaggeration to say that your fate will be decided by these midterms！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uwaaah, I don't wanna hear it anymore~!」

name: Iori
message: 「For your information, these midterms serve as the first hurdle at Murakumo Academy, where failing leads to expulsion in as little as three months.」

name: Iori
message: 「Fail these, and the gates of hell will swing wide open. Be careful.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Noooo, I don't want to flunk out~~!」

name: Iori
message: 「And these midterms are a prelude to the Martial Festival. The selection for the preliminary rounds will be decided based on your exam results.」

name: Iori
message: 「With that said, I’ve decided we’re going to do a mock exam. It’ll help you grasp your weak points properly.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~, whether it’s a mock or the real thing, I’m against exams~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We~, demand~, the abolition of exams~！」

name: Iori
message: 「These are all questions tailored to the actual content. Now, start as soon as you receive your papers.」
Even the two who were pouting have improved so much compared to before. You notice these things when you see them every day.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Grrr, Iorin just won't listen to a word I say~...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fine, if it’s come to this, I’ll show you the fruits of my extra study sessions!」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s the spirit. Now, begin！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm？ Mmm... mugugu...」
The students all start working on the mock exam in unison.
Well, let's see how this turns out...

name: Iori
message: 「...That’s time. I’ll collect the answer sheets and grade them. Wait for me for a bit.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uwaaah~, ugh, I hate this, I’m going home~！ How did you do, Setsugekka？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh my... wait, what’s this？ Could it be...」
Setsugekka makes a cryptic expression while checking her own answers.

name: Asahi
message: 「What’s the matter？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, you see... I might have actually done pretty well？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, 'cause it's Secchan we're talking about」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If you doubt it, let's put it through Momiji, the grading machine」

name: Momiji
message: 「Could you stop using me like some robot？」
Even while grumbling, Momiji accepts the self-grading results from Setsugekka.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Yeah, well, I think it's mostly correct」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Seriously！？ A total betrayal from Secchan！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「We were in the same failing group, right~? It's not cool to jump ship all by yourself~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How about you, Ririmu-chan？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, I'm not super confident, but I feel like I did better in more places than before...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa~！ Isn't that a betrayal on your part, Ririmu-chan！ Trying to pass all alone without saying a word is so unfair~」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, grading complete. You three, including Asahi, are fine. Now, for the problematic two...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-yes...」

name: Iori
message: 「Your gut feeling was right. Your scores improved quite a bit. Setsugekka, you definitely hit the passing mark. Good for you！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yayyy~~！！ I'm so happy, hooray~♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「*Gulp*... A-and what about me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, you've improved significantly too. You really worked hard.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I did~~！？ Seriously~！？ Secchan, we actually did it~~♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We won, we really won~! Let's celebrate tonight!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufu, congratulations to you both.」
The two are rejoicing as if they had just won a championship.

name: Iori
message: 「However, it's still a little too early to celebrate.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh... w-what do you mean？」
They immediately freeze in their tracks.

name: Iori
message: 「Over this past month, I've managed to get you to the point where there shouldn't be any concern about failing.」

name: Iori
message: 「However, that's just to say that you'll be able to clear the advancement criteria.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you want to make the cut for the Martial Festival preliminary roster, I have to say your results still leave room for concern.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ughhh, so it’s still not enough, huh！」

name: Iori
message: 「That said, both Ririmu and Setsugekka have improved so much compared to the beginning—it’s like night and day.」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re almost there. Let’s keep giving it our all and aiming higher without letting our guard down until the very end！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yep, yep! Of course I’ll give it my all!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’ve worked so hard to get this far, and I don’t want to have any regrets, either！」
Watching the two of them get excited, Momiji walked over.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Teacher, there isn’t actually a problem, is there?」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm？ What are you talking about？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I saw Setsugekka’s self-assessment earlier, and those aren’t the kind of scores that would hold her back in the selection process.」
Oh, so she had noticed.

name: Iori
message: 「I want to minimize the risk of them being left out of the selection as much as possible. There’s nothing wrong with pushing for excellence to achieve that, is there？」

name: Momiji
message: 「So that’s why you’re keeping it a secret from them？ You’re a bad man, aren’t you.」

name: Iori
message: 「I just don’t want them slacking off now.」
With one week left, even if they would normally be fine, I can’t afford to let them get complacent.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I suppose that might be for the best.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setting the written portion aside, are there any issues with the rest？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, the martial performance should be fine.」
They showed me the other day, and including Setsugekka, they were nearly flawless. There’s no way their evaluations would drop with that.

name: Iori
message: 「For the practical exam, you’ll be doing paired sparring practice against opponents randomly selected from your grade.」

name: Iori
message: 「The opponents and schedules will likely be announced tomorrow, so make sure none of you slack off on gathering information.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Gathering information, is it? I’m already raring to go.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Asahi, please make sure you don’t do anything illegal, okay？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, of course.」
I wonder if that’ll be alright….

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, hey, hey, Asahi! Look up my opponent too, will you? I’ll buy you some clothes as a thank you!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Certainly, leave it to me」
Asahi and Ririmu are happily chatting about the practical exam. Ever since that fight, the two of them have gotten pretty close.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Lucky Ririmu-chan~ I want someone to look up my opponent too~」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Don't worry, Setsugekka. The Kazamine family will mobilize all its resources to thoroughly investigate your opponent」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Prepare yourself to the fullest and seize a rock-solid victory」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay！ Leave the practical exam to me！」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, keep it within what's appropriate for an academy student, okay？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, don't worry. I won't do anything underhanded—probably」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What are you gonna do, Momimomi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not doing anything~ I won't lose no matter who my opponent is, after all」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, there it is—the classic oh-so-cocky Suzakuin bravado!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Showing off like that is so obnoxious, nya~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Totally, nya~」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm not showing off! I'm just stating a fact!」
Compared to a month ago, everyone really has gotten so close. It makes me strangely happy and gives me a warm, fuzzy feeling inside.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, I've got a nice surprise for all of you」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, what is it, what is it, Muragaki-sensei!」
Everyone's eyes turn to me.

name: Iori
message: 「To help you prepare for the midterm exams—and the Martial Festival beyond that—some reliable seniors have come to visit」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, seniors?! You don't mean...!」
